Return defect_label using exact label unconditional_extra_page, corrected_expression using exact expression (total + size - 1) // size, pages_20_10, pages_21_10, and pages_0_10.

Return defect_label using exact label compares_next_value, corrected_predicate using exact expression index === 0 || value !== values[index - 1], result_for_2_2_5_5_5_9 as an array, and result_length.

Reason about six workshops A, B, C, D, E, and F in distinct slots 1 through 6. C is immediately after A. F is immediately after C. B is before A. D is immediately before E. E is after F. Return the unique order as an array and the one-based slots of A, D, and F.
Return exactly one JSON object, with no prose or Markdown, using only the requested keys. All amounts are integer cents.

Analyze a fund that starts with 30,000 cents. It invests 40% in X, then invests half of the remaining cash in Y. X gains 25%. Y loses one third of its value. Finally, a 750-cent fee is paid from cash. Return x_final, y_final, cash_final, total_final, and net_change from the starting amount.
